notes.units: cost: $ million per year; carbon: t CO2e per year; days = line-haul transit D/v (2 = truckload, 4 = intermodal rail)
notes.decisions: n = number of distribution centers (continuous, as in the model); days = line-haul transit time, the speed decision
notes.components: cost: facilities, safety_stock (holding h*S), stock_in_transit (financing h_p*P), inbound_freight t(v)*N*mu*D, local_delivery t_L*N*mu*d(n); carbon: same without stock_in_transit
notes.slices: vary_n_fixed_v: n moves, line haul fixed at the cost-minimizing speed; vary_v_fixed_n: speed moves, n fixed at the cost minimum; vary_n_best_v / vary_v_best_n: the other decision re-optimized for COST at each value
notes.bounds: speed between 250 (rail) and 500 (truckload) miles a day, so days in [2, 4]; n from 1 to 30 shown (model allows up to N=40)
